subject: [PATCH v4 08/19] selftests/mm: add folio-order check for address ranges

2026-08-20.patch_summary: This patch adds a new function called is_range_backed_by_folio_orders() to the Linux kernel's selftests/mm module. The function checks whether an address range can be collapsed into folios of a specific order, ensuring that each window of the range maps exactly one folio and that the folios are contiguous. This check is necessary for mTHP (memory Transparent Huge Pages) collapse tests, which require accurate identification of collapsed windows. The patch introduces a new function to perform this check, allowing for more robust testing of memory management features in the kernel.
